clauses.quote: Teachers must be allowed to participate in the various stages of staff and curriculum development.
The SCAC, in consultation with Teachers, may develop surveys to seek information about the training of, and assistance provided to, Teachers on the topic of improving student achievement.

The Building Representative, after conducting such a survey, will share the results with the LSRT, staff and local school Supervisor for consideration during the professional development deliberations for local school plan policy recommendations.
